mapper.select: select m.emp_no,m.emp_name,m.phone_no, group_concat(ei.FACTORY_ID) as factory_id, group_concat(fm.field_name) as factory_name, max(ei.POWER_END_TIME) as power_end_time from safety_employee_message m left join safety_park_employee_power_info ei on m.emp_no = ei.EMPLOYEE_CODE and ei.IS_DELETE = '0' left join safety_field_manage fm on ei.FACTORY_ID = fm.id where m.status = 'NORMAL' and m.emp_no in ( select distinct d.EMPLOYEE_CODE from safety_park_power_process p inner join safety_park_power_process_detail d on p.id = d.PROCESS_ID where p.id = #{processId} ) group by m.emp_no, m.emp_name, m.phone_no
